verses.original: אִם־ תָּשׁ֨וּב יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל׀ תָּשׁ֑וּב אֵלַ֖י נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֛ה וְאִם־ תָּסִ֧יר שִׁקּוּצֶ֛יךָ מִפָּנַ֖י וְלֹ֥א תָנֽוּד׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- tā·šūḇ yiś·rā·’êl tā·šūḇ ’ê·lay nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·’im- tā·sîr šiq·qū·ṣe·ḵā mip·pā·nay wə·lō ṯā·nūḏ
verses.literal: If you will return O Israel return to Me declares the LORD If you will remove your detestable idols from My sight and no longer waver

verses.original: וְנִשְׁבַּ֙עְתָּ֙ יְהוָ֔ה חַי־ בֶּאֱמֶ֖ת בְּמִשְׁפָּ֣ט וּבִצְדָקָ֑ה גּוֹיִ֖ם וְהִתְבָּ֥רְכוּ וּב֥וֹ ב֛וֹ יִתְהַלָּֽלוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·niš·ba‘·tā Yah·weh ḥay- be·’ĕ·meṯ bə·miš·pāṭ ū·ḇiṣ·ḏā·qāh gō·w·yim wə·hiṯ·bā·rə·ḵū ū·ḇōw ḇōw yiṯ·hal·lā·lū
verses.literal: and if you can swear As surely as the LORD lives in truth in justice and in righteousness then the nations will be blessed by Him and in Him they will glory

verses.original: כִּי־ כֹ֣ה׀ יְהֹוָ֗ה אָמַ֣ר לְאִ֤ישׁ יְהוּדָה֙ וְלִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם נִ֥ירוּ לָכֶ֖ם נִ֑יר וְאַֽל־ תִּזְרְע֖וּ אֶל־ קוֹצִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḵōh Yah·weh ’ā·mar lə·’îš yə·hū·ḏāh wə·lî·rū·šā·lim nî·rū lā·ḵem nîr wə·’al- tiz·rə·‘ū ’el- qō·w·ṣîm
verses.literal: For this is what the LORD says to the men of Judah and Jerusalem Break up your unplowed ground and do not sow among the thorns

verses.original: הִמֹּ֣לוּ לַיהֹוָ֗ה וְהָסִ֙רוּ֙ עָרְל֣וֹת לְבַבְכֶ֔ם אִ֥ישׁ יְהוּדָ֖ה וְיֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם פֶּן־ חֲמָתִ֗י תֵּצֵ֨א כָאֵ֜שׁ וּבָעֲרָה֙ וְאֵ֣ין מְכַבֶּ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י רֹ֥עַ מַעַלְלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: him·mō·lū Yah·weh wə·hā·si·rū ‘ā·rə·lō·wṯ lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem ’îš yə·hū·ḏāh wə·yō·šə·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim pen- ḥă·mā·ṯî tê·ṣê ḵā·’êš ū·ḇā·‘ă·rāh wə·’ên mə·ḵab·beh mip·pə·nê rō·a‘ ma·‘al·lê·ḵem
verses.literal: Circumcise yourselves to the LORD and remove the foreskins of your hearts O men of Judah and people of Jerusalem Otherwise My wrath will break out like fire and burn with no one to extinguish it because of your evil deeds

verses.original: הַגִּ֣ידוּ בִֽיהוּדָ֗ה הַשְׁמִ֔יעוּ וּבִירוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ וְאִמְר֕וּ וְתִקְעוּ שׁוֹפָ֖ר בָּאָ֑רֶץ קִרְא֤וּ מַלְאוּ֙ וְאִמְר֔וּ הֵאָסְפ֥וּ וְנָב֖וֹאָה אֶל־ הַמִּבְצָֽר׃ עָרֵ֥י
verses.transliteration: hag·gî·ḏū ḇî·hū·ḏāh haš·mî·‘ū ū·ḇî·rū·šā·lim wə·’im·rū wə·ṯiq·ʿū šō·w·p̄ār bā·’ā·reṣ qir·’ū mal·’ū wə·’im·rū hê·’ā·sə·p̄ū wə·nā·ḇō·w·’āh ’el- ham·miḇ·ṣār ‘ā·rê
verses.literal: Announce in Judah proclaim in Jerusalem and say Blow the ram’s horn throughout the land Cry aloud . . . and say Assemble yourselves and let us flee to the fortified cities

verses.original: שְׂאוּ־ נֵ֣ס צִיּ֔וֹנָה הָעִ֖יזוּ אַֽל־ תַּעֲמֹ֑דוּ כִּ֣י אָנֹכִ֛י מֵבִ֥יא רָעָ֗ה מִצָּפ֖וֹן גָּדֽוֹל׃ וְשֶׁ֥בֶר
verses.transliteration: śə·’ū- nês ṣî·yō·w·nāh hā·‘î·zū ’al- ta·‘ă·mō·ḏū kî ’ā·nō·ḵî mê·ḇî rā·‘āh miṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn gā·ḏō·wl wə·še·ḇer
verses.literal: Raise a signal flag toward Zion Seek refuge Do not delay For I am bringing disaster from the north and terrible destruction

verses.original: אַרְיֵה֙ עָלָ֤ה מִֽסֻּבְּכ֔וֹ וּמַשְׁחִ֣ית גּוֹיִ֔ם נָסַ֖ע יָצָ֣א מִמְּקֹמ֑וֹ לָשׂ֤וּם לְשַׁמָּ֔ה אַרְצֵךְ֙ עָרַ֥יִךְ מֵאֵ֥ין תִּצֶּ֖ינָה יוֹשֵֽׁב׃
verses.transliteration: ’ar·yêh ‘ā·lāh mis·sub·bə·ḵōw ū·maš·ḥîṯ gō·w·yim nā·sa‘ yā·ṣā mim·mə·qō·mōw lā·śūm lə·šam·māh ’ar·ṣêḵ ‘ā·ra·yiḵ mê·’ên tiṣ·ṣe·nāh yō·wō·šêḇ
verses.literal: A lion has gone up from his thicket and a destroyer of nations has set out He has left his lair to lay waste your land Your cities will be reduced to ruins and lie uninhabited

verses.original: עַל־ זֹ֛את חִגְר֥וּ שַׂקִּ֖ים סִפְד֣וּ וְהֵילִ֑ילוּ כִּ֥י חֲר֥וֹן אַף־ יְהֹוָ֖ה לֹא־ שָׁ֛ב מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: ‘al- zōṯ ḥiḡ·rū śaq·qîm sip̄·ḏū wə·hê·lî·lū kî ḥă·rō·wn ’ap̄- Yah·weh lō- šāḇ mim·men·nū
verses.literal: So . . . put on sackcloth mourn and wail for the fierce anger of the LORD has not turned away from us

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה הַהוּא֙ בַיּוֹם־ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וְלֵ֣ב הַשָּׂרִ֑ים יֹאבַ֥ד לֵב־ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים וְנָשַׁ֙מּוּ֙ וְהַנְּבִיאִ֖ים יִתְמָֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ha·hū ḇay·yō·wm- nə·’um- Yah·weh ham·me·leḵ wə·lêḇ haś·śā·rîm yō·ḇaḏ lêḇ- hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·nā·šam·mū wə·han·nə·ḇî·’îm yiṯ·mā·hū
verses.literal: - In that day declares the LORD the king . . . and officials will lose their courage The priests will tremble in fear and the prophets will be astounded

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֞ר אֲהָ֣הּ׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה אָכֵן֩ הַשֵּׁ֨א הִשֵּׁ֜אתָ הַזֶּה֙ לָעָ֤ם וְלִירוּשָׁלִַ֣ם לֵאמֹ֔ר יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם וְנָגְעָ֥ה שָׁל֖וֹם חֶ֖רֶב עַד־ הַנָּֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar ’ă·hāh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·ḵên haš·šê hiš·šê·ṯā haz·zeh lā·‘ām wə·lî·rū·šā·lim lê·mōr yih·yeh lā·ḵem wə·nā·ḡə·‘āh šā·lō·wm ḥe·reḇ ‘aḏ- han·nā·p̄eš
verses.literal: Then I said Ah Lord GOD how completely You have deceived . . . this people and Jerusalem by saying You will have - peace while a sword is at our throats

verses.original: הַהִ֗יא בָּעֵ֣ת יֵאָמֵ֤ר הַזֶּה֙ לָֽעָם־ וְלִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם צַ֤ח ר֣וּחַ שְׁפָיִים֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר דֶּ֖רֶךְ בַּת־ עַמִּ֑י ל֥וֹא לִזְר֖וֹת וְל֥וֹא לְהָבַֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ha·hî bā·‘êṯ yê·’ā·mêr haz·zeh lā·‘ām- wə·lî·rū·šā·lim ṣaḥ rū·aḥ šə·p̄ā·yîm bam·miḏ·bār de·reḵ baṯ- ‘am·mî lō·w liz·rō·wṯ wə·lō·w lə·hā·ḇar
verses.literal: At that time it will be said to this people and to Jerusalem A searing wind from the barren heights in the desert blows toward the daughter of My people but not to winnow . . . or to sift

verses.original: ר֧וּחַ מָלֵ֛א מֵאֵ֖לֶּה יָ֣בוֹא לִ֑י עַתָּ֕ה אֲנִ֛י גַּם־ אֲדַבֵּ֥ר מִשְׁפָּטִ֖ים אוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: rū·aḥ mā·lê mê·’êl·leh yā·ḇō·w lî ‘at·tāh ’ă·nî gam- ’ă·ḏab·bêr miš·pā·ṭîm ’ō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: a wind too strong for that comes from Me Now I also pronounce judgments against them

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה׀ יַעֲלֶ֗ה כַּעֲנָנִ֣ים מַרְכְּבוֹתָ֔יו וְכַסּוּפָה֙ סוּסָ֑יו קַלּ֥וּ מִנְּשָׁרִ֖ים א֥וֹי לָ֖נוּ כִּ֥י שֻׁדָּֽדְנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ya·‘ă·leh ka·‘ă·nā·nîm mar·kə·ḇō·w·ṯāw wə·ḵas·sū·p̄āh sū·sāw qal·lū min·nə·šā·rîm ’ō·w lā·nū kî šud·dā·ḏə·nū
verses.literal: Behold he advances like the clouds his chariots like the whirlwind His horses are swifter than eagles Woe to us for we are ruined

verses.original: כַּבְּסִ֨י מֵרָעָ֤ה לִבֵּךְ֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם לְמַ֖עַן תִּוָּשֵׁ֑עִי עַד־ מָתַ֛י תָּלִ֥ין אוֹנֵֽךְ׃ מַחְשְׁב֥וֹת בְּקִרְבֵּ֖ךְ
verses.transliteration: kab·bə·sî mê·rā·‘āh lib·bêḵ yə·rū·šā·lim lə·ma·‘an tiw·wā·šê·‘î ‘aḏ- mā·ṯay tā·lîn ’ō·w·nêḵ maḥ·šə·ḇō·wṯ bə·qir·bêḵ
verses.literal: Wash the evil from your heart O Jerusalem so that you may be saved How long . . . will you harbor wicked thoughts within you

verses.original: כִּ֛י ק֥וֹל מַגִּ֖יד מִדָּ֑ן וּמַשְׁמִ֥יעַ אָ֖וֶן מֵהַ֥ר אֶפְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: kî qō·wl mag·gîḏ mid·dān ū·maš·mî·a‘ ’ā·wen mê·har ’ep̄·rā·yim
verses.literal: For a voice resounds from Dan proclaiming disaster from the hills of Ephraim

verses.original: הַזְכִּ֣ירוּ לַגּוֹיִ֗ם הִנֵּה֙ הַשְׁמִ֣יעוּ עַל־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם נֹצְרִ֥ים בָּאִ֖ים הַמֶּרְחָ֑ק מֵאֶ֣רֶץ וַֽיִּתְּנ֛וּ קוֹלָֽם׃ עַל־ עָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: haz·kî·rū lag·gō·w·yim hin·nêh haš·mî·‘ū ‘al- yə·rū·šā·lim nō·ṣə·rîm bā·’îm ham·mer·ḥāq mê·’e·reṣ way·yit·tə·nū qō·w·lām ‘al- ‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: Warn the nations now Proclaim to Jerusalem A besieging army comes from a distant land they raise their voices against the cities of Judah

verses.original: מִסָּבִ֑יב כְּשֹׁמְרֵ֣י שָׂדַ֔י הָי֥וּ עָלֶ֖יהָ כִּי־ אֹתִ֥י מָרָ֖תָה נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mis·sā·ḇîḇ kə·šō·mə·rê śā·ḏay hā·yū ‘ā·le·hā kî- ’ō·ṯî mā·rā·ṯāh nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: They surround her like men guarding a field . . . . . . because - she has rebelled against Me declares the LORD

verses.original: דַּרְכֵּךְ֙ וּמַ֣עֲלָלַ֔יִךְ עָשׂ֥וֹ אֵ֖לֶּה לָ֑ךְ זֹ֤את רָעָתֵךְ֙ מָ֔ר כִּ֥י כִּ֣י נָגַ֖ע עַד־ לִבֵּֽךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: dar·kêḵ ū·ma·‘ă·lā·la·yiḵ ‘ā·śōw ’êl·leh lāḵ zōṯ rā·‘ā·ṯêḵ mār kî kî nā·ḡa‘ ‘aḏ- lib·bêḵ
verses.literal: Your ways and deeds have brought this upon you This is your punishment how bitter it is . . . because it pierces to the heart

verses.original: מֵעַ֣י׀ מֵעַ֨י׀ אָחוּלָה קִיר֥וֹת לִבִּ֛י לִבִּ֖י הֹֽמֶה־ לִּ֥י לֹ֣א אַחֲרִ֑ישׁ כִּ֣י נַפְשִׁ֔י שָׁמַעְתִּי ק֤וֹל שׁוֹפָר֙ תְּרוּעַ֖ת מִלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mê·‘ay mê·‘ay ʾå̄·ḥū·lå̄h qî·rō·wṯ lib·bî lib·bî hō·meh- lî lō ’a·ḥă·rîš kî nap̄·šî šå̄·maʿ·tī qō·wl šō·w·p̄ār tə·rū·‘aṯ mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: My anguish my anguish I writhe in pain Oh, the pain in my chest My heart pounds within me I cannot be silent For I have heard the sound of the horn the alarm of battle

verses.original: שֶׁ֤בֶר עַל־ שֶׁ֙בֶר֙ נִקְרָ֔א כִּ֥י כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ שֻׁדְּדָ֖ה אֹהָלַ֔י שֻׁדְּד֣וּ פִּתְאֹם֙ יְרִיעֹתָֽי׃ רֶ֖גַע
verses.transliteration: še·ḇer ‘al- še·ḇer niq·rā kî kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ šud·də·ḏāh ’ō·hā·lay šud·də·ḏū piṯ·’ōm yə·rî·‘ō·ṯāy re·ḡa‘
verses.literal: Disaster after disaster is proclaimed for the whole land is laid waste My tents are destroyed in an instant my curtains in a moment

verses.original: עַד־ מָתַ֖י אֶרְאֶה־ נֵּ֑ס אֶשְׁמְעָ֖ה ק֥וֹל שׁוֹפָֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ- mā·ṯay ’er·’eh- nês ’eš·mə·‘āh qō·wl šō·w·p̄ār
verses.literal: How long . . . must I see the signal flag and hear the sound of the horn

verses.original: כִּ֣י׀ עַמִּ֗י אוֹתִי֙ אֱוִ֣יל לֹ֣א יָדָ֔עוּ הֵ֔מָּה סְכָלִים֙ בָּנִ֤ים וְלֹ֥א נְבוֹנִ֖ים הֵ֑מָּה חֲכָמִ֥ים הֵ֙מָּה֙ לְהָרַ֔ע יָדָֽעוּ׃ לֹ֥א וּלְהֵיטִ֖יב
verses.transliteration: kî ‘am·mî ’ō·w·ṯî ’ĕ·wîl lō yā·ḏā·‘ū hêm·māh sə·ḵā·lîm bā·nîm wə·lō nə·ḇō·w·nîm hêm·māh ḥă·ḵā·mîm hêm·māh lə·hā·ra‘ yā·ḏā·‘ū lō ū·lə·hê·ṭîḇ
verses.literal: For My people - are fools they have not known Me They are foolish children without understanding They are skilled . . . in doing evil but they know not how to do good

verses.original: רָאִ֙יתִי֙ אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וְהִנֵּה־ תֹ֖הוּ וָבֹ֑הוּ וְאֶל־ הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְאֵ֥ין אוֹרָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: rā·’î·ṯî ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·hin·nêh- ṯō·hū wā·ḇō·hū wə·’el- haš·šā·ma·yim wə·’ên ’ō·w·rām
verses.literal: I looked - at the earth . . . and it was formless and void [I looked] to the heavens and they [had] no light

verses.original: רָאִ֙יתִי֙ הֶֽהָרִ֔ים וְהִנֵּ֖ה רֹעֲשִׁ֑ים וְכָל־ הַגְּבָע֖וֹת הִתְקַלְקָֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: rā·’î·ṯî he·hā·rîm wə·hin·nêh rō·‘ă·šîm wə·ḵāl hag·gə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ hiṯ·qal·qā·lū
verses.literal: I looked at the mountains and behold they were quaking all the hills were swaying

verses.original: רָאִ֕יתִי וְהִנֵּ֖ה אֵ֣ין הָאָדָ֑ם וְכָל־ ע֥וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם נָדָֽדוּ׃
verses.transliteration: rā·’î·ṯî wə·hin·nêh ’ên hā·’ā·ḏām wə·ḵāl ‘ō·wp̄ haš·šā·ma·yim nā·ḏā·ḏū
verses.literal: I looked . . . and no man was left all the birds of the air had fled

verses.original: רָאִ֕יתִי וְהִנֵּ֥ה הַכַּרְמֶ֖ל הַמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְכָל־ עָרָ֗יו נִתְּצוּ֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י חֲר֥וֹן אַפּֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: rā·’î·ṯî wə·hin·nêh hak·kar·mel ham·miḏ·bār wə·ḵāl ‘ā·rāw nit·tə·ṣū mip·pə·nê Yah·weh mip·pə·nê ḥă·rō·wn ’ap·pōw
verses.literal: I looked . . . and the fruitful land was a desert All its cities were torn down before the LORD before His fierce anger

verses.original: כִּי־ כֹה֙ יְהוָ֔ה אָמַ֣ר כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ תִהְיֶ֖ה שְׁמָמָ֥ה לֹ֥א וְכָלָ֖ה אֶעֱשֶֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḵōh Yah·weh ’ā·mar kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ ṯih·yeh šə·mā·māh lō wə·ḵā·lāh ’e·‘ĕ·śeh
verses.literal: For this is what the LORD says The whole land will be desolate but I will not finish its destruction . . .

verses.original: עַל־ זֹאת֙ הָאָ֔רֶץ תֶּאֱבַ֣ל הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם מִמָּ֑עַל עַ֤ל כִּי־ וְקָדְר֥וּ דִבַּ֙רְתִּי֙ זַמֹּ֔תִי וְלֹ֥א נִחַ֖מְתִּי וְלֹא־ אָשׁ֥וּב מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- zōṯ hā·’ā·reṣ te·’ĕ·ḇal haš·šā·ma·yim mim·mā·‘al ‘al kî- wə·qā·ḏə·rū ḏib·bar·tî zam·mō·ṯî wə·lō ni·ḥam·tî wə·lō- ’ā·šūḇ mim·men·nāh
verses.literal: Therefore . . . the earth will mourn [and] the heavens above . . . . . . will grow dark I have spoken I have planned and I will not relent . . . or turn back . . .

verses.original: כָּל־ הָעִ֔יר בֹּרַ֙חַת֙ מִקּ֨וֹל פָּרָ֜שׁ וְרֹ֣מֵה קֶ֗שֶׁת בָּ֚אוּ בֶּעָבִ֔ים עָל֑וּ וּבַכֵּפִ֖ים כָּל־ הָעִ֣יר עֲזוּבָ֔ה וְאֵין־ יוֹשֵׁ֥ב בָּהֵ֖ן אִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- hā·‘îr bō·ra·ḥaṯ miq·qō·wl pā·rāš wə·rō·mêh qe·šeṯ bā·’ū be·‘ā·ḇîm ‘ā·lū ū·ḇak·kê·p̄îm kāl- hā·‘îr ‘ă·zū·ḇāh wə·’ên- yō·wō·šêḇ bā·hên ’îš
verses.literal: Every city flees at the sound of the horseman and archer . . . They enter the thickets and climb among the rocks Every city is abandoned no inhabitant is left . . . . . .

verses.original: וְאַתִּי שָׁד֜וּד מַֽה־ תַּעֲשִׂ֗י כִּֽי־ תִלְבְּשִׁ֨י שָׁנִ֜י כִּי־ תַעְדִּ֣י זָהָ֗ב עֲדִי־ כִּֽי־ תִקְרְעִ֤י עֵינַ֔יִךְ בַפּוּךְ֙ תִּתְיַפִּ֑י לַשָּׁ֖וְא עֹגְבִ֖ים מָאֲסוּ־ בָ֥ךְ יְבַקֵּֽשׁוּ׃ נַפְשֵׁ֥ךְ
verses.transliteration: wə·ʾat·tī šā·ḏūḏ mah- ta·‘ă·śî kî- ṯil·bə·šî šā·nî kî- ṯa‘·dî zā·hāḇ ‘ă·ḏî- kî- ṯiq·rə·‘î ‘ê·na·yiḵ ḇap·pūḵ tiṯ·yap·pî laš·šāw ‘ō·ḡə·ḇîm mā·’ă·sū- ḇāḵ yə·ḇaq·qê·šū nap̄·šêḵ
verses.literal: And you O devastated one what will you do though you dress yourself in scarlet though you adorn yourself with gold jewelry though you enlarge your eyes with paint You adorn yourself in vain your lovers despise you they want to take your life

verses.original: כִּי֩ שָׁמַ֗עְתִּי ק֨וֹל כְּחוֹלָ֜ה צָרָה֙ כְּמַבְכִּירָ֔ה ק֧וֹל בַּת־ צִיּ֛וֹן תִּתְיַפֵּ֖חַ תְּפָרֵ֣שׂ כַּפֶּ֑יהָ אֽוֹי־ נָ֣א לִ֔י כִּֽי־ נַפְשִׁ֖י עָיְפָ֥ה לְהֹרְגִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: kî šā·ma‘·tî qō·wl kə·ḥō·w·lāh ṣā·rāh kə·maḇ·kî·rāh qō·wl baṯ- ṣî·yō·wn tiṯ·yap·pê·aḥ tə·p̄ā·rêś kap·pe·hā ’ō·w- nā lî kî- nap̄·šî ‘ā·yə·p̄āh lə·hō·rə·ḡîm
verses.literal: For I hear a cry like a woman in labor a cry of anguish like one bearing her first child the cry of the Daughter of Zion gasping for breath stretching out her hands [to say] Woe is me . . . for my soul faints before the murderers
